sentence: The confirmatory run used 600 honest jobs (200 untouched test prompts × 3 seeds) generated on a newly rented RTX 4090: E2-H with one checked step rejected 1.3% of them under v2 (8 jobs; 95% interval 0.5–2.5%, clustered by prompt), against 1.2% on the test split, so the pre-registered criterion (at most 2.0%, upper bound at most 3.0%) was met; E0 rejected 1.2%.
